issues.title: mobskill command is registered at rank 0
issues.summary: MobSkillCommand is in the gm2 package but is registered through the rank-0 overload, allowing ordinary-player invocation through the @ prefix.
issues.required_close: Register at the intended staff rank and add regression coverage for player rejection. Review gachalist and loot rank intent in the same registration block.

issues.title: startevent single participant-limit argument is ignored
issues.summary: The command only parses params[0] when params.length > 1, so one numeric limit argument leaves the default capacity of 50.
issues.required_close: Correct and test command argument handling.

issues.title: Account purge semantics can leave character-related rows
issues.summary: Final account deletion/restoration and dependent character/inventory/equipment/quest/social cleanup policy remains unresolved.
issues.required_close: Define policy, validate relationship integrity, implement safe cleanup behavior, and test it.

issues.title: Raw EXE launch bypasses the supported managed-client path
issues.summary: Direct game executable launches can bypass launcher update/repair and launcher-ticket/bootstrap assumptions.
issues.required_close: Complete clear raw-EXE handling and clean-machine launcher/install/update/repair validation.

issues.title: Account recovery is staff-queue based rather than automated reset-token flow
issues.summary: The public recovery form creates a deduplicated staff-reviewed request; it does not send an automated password-reset token/email.
issues.required_close: Only close if a deliberate self-service recovery flow is implemented, tested, deployed, and documented; otherwise retain as an accepted limitation.
